parameters.itemBuilder: Builds item index's content, laid out at the focal size and masked.
parameters.height: Sets the height of the media frame.
parameters.padding: Insets before the first and after the last item (main axis), and above and below the items (cross axis).
parameters.itemCorner: The corner every item's mask is rounded by.
parameters.controller: Drives the carousel and reports its current item.
parameters.onItemTap: Receives the index of the tapped slide.
parameters.style: Overrides the component’s themed appearance for this instance.
parameters.semanticLabel: What a screen reader calls the carousel.
parameters.minSmallItemWidth: The smallest a small item may be (Compose's MinSmallItemSize).
parameters.maxSmallItemWidth: The largest a small item may be (Compose's MaxSmallItemSize).

keyboardNote: Use the Previous and Next buttons to move the ExpressiveCarouselController by one room.
